# meok-fmcsa-hours-of-service-mcp

> US FMCSA Hours of Service + CSA score forecast + ELD mandate + New Entrant Safety Audit prep. 49 CFR Part 395 / Part 385 callable compliance toolkit for property + passenger carriers. By MEOK AI Labs.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- check_property_carrying_hos
- check_passenger_carrying_hos
- check_short_haul_exemption
- check_eld_mandate_compliance
- check_eld_supplier_registered
- forecast_csa_score
- audit_iep_inspection
- prepare_safety_audit_pack

## Install
```
pip install meok-fmcsa-hours-of-service-mcp
```

- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/meok-fmcsa-hours-of-service-mcp/
